answer: One defence is Keybase proof chain across three services: proofs on three services tied to one key, and the walnut of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Fakes fail here because proofs on three services tied to one key is tied to something outside the network; the delta of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the vine of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
